welcome.title: Welcome to Lumix
welcome.description: Select a server from the sidebar or create a new one

dashboard.description: Review server runtime state, resource allocation, and items that need attention in one place.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Lumix helps you choose a Minecraft version, prepare the Java runtime, and move directly into a manageable server workflow after creation.

emptySteps.version: Choose the Minecraft version and core type
emptySteps.launch: Create the server and inspect live output

dashboard.noFilteredServersDescription: Switch filters or create a new server.

server.name: Server Name
server.consoleHint: Logs will appear here after the server starts
server.clearConsoleConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all logs? This action cannot be undone.
server.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this server?
server.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. All server data will be permanently deleted.
server.settingsDescription: Manage launch settings and server.properties in one place. Most changes apply after the server is stopped.
server.settingsLocked: Settings cannot be changed while the server is running. Stop the server first.
server.readyDescription: Server files are ready. You can start the server now or adjust settings first.
server.downloadingDescription: The server core is still being prepared. It can start after the download finishes.
server.runtimeRunningDescription: The server is running and the console will show live output. Settings are temporarily locked.
server.runtimeTransitionDescription: The server is changing state. Wait for the current action to finish.
server.runtimeStoppedDescription: The server is stopped. You can edit settings, open the folder, or start it.
server.settingsPreviewDescription: Common server.properties options now live on a dedicated page, covering gameplay, world generation, network, and performance.
server.settingsPreviewPendingDescription: Only basic settings and backups are available right now. server.properties is generated after the first successful server start, so advanced gameplay and network settings appear later.
server.serverPropertiesPending: server.properties has not been generated yet. Start the server successfully once, then return here to edit gameplay, world, and network settings.

connection.title: Connection Info & Diagnostics
connection.listening: Lumix detected a local process listening on this Minecraft port.
connection.notListening: Lumix did not detect a local listener on this Minecraft port yet.
connection.boundToSpecificIp: server.properties is currently bound to `{{ip}}`, which may affect localhost or LAN connection behavior.
connection.boundToAllInterfaces: server.properties does not set `server-ip`, which usually means it can bind to all available interfaces.

local.title: Same PC
local.description: When testing on this Windows PC, use `localhost` with the current port.

lan.title: Same LAN
lan.description: Players on the same network usually need this LAN IP and the same port.
lan.unavailable: Lumix could not find a usable LAN IPv4 this time, so no shareable LAN address is available yet.

wan.title: WAN / External
wan.description: This only shows the public IP as a reference. External access usually still requires router port forwarding, and Lumix cannot configure the router automatically.

help.wan: External sharing: port forwarding is usually still required, and Lumix can only help diagnose the setup rather than guarantee WAN reachability.

firewall.unknown: No firewall hint is currently available.
firewall.allowed: Lumix found a Windows inbound rule that allows this TCP port.
firewall.blocked: Windows Firewall appears likely to block this port.
firewall.warning: Lumix could not confirm that Windows Firewall allows this port. Check the inbound rules manually.

SERVER_IP_BOUND.title: Server is bound to a specific IP

WAN_REQUIRES_PORT_FORWARDING.title: WAN usually still needs port forwarding

CGNAT_SUSPECTED.title: CGNAT or ISP limits may apply

FIREWALL_MAY_BLOCK.title: Windows Firewall may still block access

backup.title: Server Backups
backup.description: Create server snapshots at the selected time. Backups are stored in the server folder and only the latest 3 are retained.
backup.includeLogsDescription: Turn off to reduce backup size
backup.notifyOpsDescription: Notify OPs in-game when scheduled backups start, finish, or fail
backup.manualDescription: Create a snapshot immediately. When the server is running, Lumix sends save commands before copying files.
backup.retention: Lumix automatically removes older backups and keeps the latest 3.
backup.restoreLocked: Stop the server before restoring a backup.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore "{{name}}"? Current server files will be overwritten by this backup.
backup.restoreDialogDescription: Review the restore preflight before overwriting the current server files.
backup.restoreDestructiveNotice: Restoring overwrites the current world data, server.properties, and related admin files. Keeping a pre-restore backup is recommended.
backup.createPreRestoreBackupDescription: Enabled by default so you can return to the current state if the restore result is not what you expected.

onboarding.title: Next Steps
onboarding.description: The server is created. Use this checklist to verify the folder, core settings, connection notes, and your first backup.
onboarding.dismissedDescription: You dismissed the first-run guide, but you can reopen it anytime to finish the remaining setup steps.
onboarding.completedDescription: This server's first-run onboarding is complete.

folder.label: Open folder
folder.description: Check the server directory, core files, and output location.

settings.label: Review settings
settings.description: Inspect RAM, Java, and important server.properties values.

start.label: Start now
start.description: Launch the server directly when it is ready.

connection.title: Connection Info
connection.description: This view shows the same connection info and diagnostics as the main server detail page.
connection.sameDevice: For testing on the same PC, use `localhost` with the current port.
connection.sameNetwork: Players on the same network usually need your LAN IP and the same port. More complete LAN details will land in Phase 3.
connection.wan: External access usually still requires router port forwarding. Lumix does not pretend it can automate that today.
connection.phaseNote: Full LAN / WAN diagnostics are out of scope for this Phase 2 implementation.

review-folder-core.title: Review server folder and core
review-folder-core.description: Confirm the server directory and make sure the downloaded core looks correct.

review-memory-java.title: Review memory and Java
review-memory-java.description: Inspect the current RAM allocation and Java path before first launch.
review-memory-java.blockedReason: No usable Java path is available yet. Set up Java first, then review this step.

review-properties.title: Open essential server.properties
review-properties.description: Review gameplay and network settings after the first launch, because server.properties is generated at that point.
review-properties.blockedReason: server.properties is not available yet. Start the server successfully once first.

review-connection.title: Review connection info
review-connection.description: Review local, LAN, and WAN addresses together with the current diagnostics.
review-connection.blockedReason: The current `server-port` could not be read yet. Confirm server.properties exists first.

start-server.title: Start server
start-server.description: Verify that the server can launch successfully. This step completes automatically once the server is running.
start-server.blockedReason: The server core is still being prepared. Start becomes available after the download finishes.

create-backup.title: Create first backup
create-backup.description: This step is optional, but it is a good idea before major config changes or your first live session.

onboardingPrompt.title: Open the post-create onboarding?
onboardingPrompt.description: Lumix can walk you through the first-time setup flow for this new server, including the folder, settings, connection notes, and the first backup.

players.title: Player Management
players.description: Review known and online players, then run OP, ban, kick, and whitelist actions quickly.
players.emptyRunning: Players appear here after they join. Refresh also sends the list command to the server.
players.emptyStopped: Start the server and wait for players to join; Lumix reads UUIDs from usercache.json.

gamemode.label: Default Game Mode
gamemode.description: Game mode used when new players join.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Controls hostile mobs, damage, hunger, and overall world difficulty.

max-players.label: Max Players
max-players.description: Maximum number of players allowed online at the same time.

pvp.label: Allow PvP
pvp.description: When enabled, players can damage each other.

hardcore.label: Hardcore Mode
hardcore.description: Dead players enter spectator mode, suited for high-risk worlds.

force-gamemode.label: Force Game Mode
force-gamemode.description: Players are reset to the default game mode whenever they join.

allow-flight.label: Allow Flight
allow-flight.description: Allows flying, commonly needed for modded or creative servers.

white-list.label: Enable Whitelist
white-list.description: Only players on the whitelist can join.

enforce-whitelist.label: Enforce Whitelist
enforce-whitelist.description: Kicks players who are no longer allowed after whitelist changes.

online-mode.label: Online Mode
online-mode.description: Verifies player identity through Mojang/Microsoft authentication.

server-port.label: Server Port
server-port.description: TCP port players use to connect.

server-ip.label: Bind IP
server-ip.description: Usually left blank so the server listens on all available interfaces.

enable-status.label: Public Status
enable-status.description: Allows clients to show status and MOTD in the server list.

enable-query.label: Enable Query
enable-query.description: Exposes GameSpy4 query data for external status tools.

query.port.label: Query Port
query.port.description: UDP port used by the query protocol.

enable-rcon.label: Enable RCON
enable-rcon.description: Allows remote administration tools to send commands through RCON.

rcon.port.label: RCON Port
rcon.port.description: Port used by RCON remote administration.

rcon.password.label: RCON Password
rcon.password.description: Remote administration password. Set this before enabling RCON.

motd.label: MOTD
motd.description: Welcome message shown in the Minecraft server list.

level-name.label: World Folder
level-name.description: World folder the server loads or creates.

level-seed.label: World Seed
level-seed.description: Seed used for new world generation; existing worlds usually do not change.

level-type.label: World Type
level-type.description: World generation type, such as minecraft:normal or flat.

generate-structures.label: Generate Structures
generate-structures.description: Controls whether villages, strongholds, and other structures generate.

allow-nether.label: Allow Nether
allow-nether.description: Allows players to enter the Nether dimension.

spawn-animals.label: Spawn Animals
spawn-animals.description: Controls natural spawning for friendly animals.

spawn-monsters.label: Spawn Monsters
spawn-monsters.description: Controls natural spawning for hostile mobs.

spawn-npcs.label: Spawn NPCs
spawn-npcs.description: Controls spawning for villagers and other NPCs.

spawn-protection.label: Spawn Protection
spawn-protection.description: Protected block radius around the world spawn.

view-distance.label: View Distance
view-distance.description: Chunk distance sent to players. Higher values increase server load.

simulation-distance.label: Simulation Distance
simulation-distance.description: Chunk distance where entities and block ticks are simulated.

enable-command-block.label: Command Blocks
enable-command-block.description: Allows command blocks to execute commands.

op-permission-level.label: OP Permission Level
op-permission-level.description: Permission level for operators, from 1 to 4.

function-permission-level.label: Function Permission Level
function-permission-level.description: Permission level used when datapack functions execute commands.

player-idle-timeout.label: Idle Timeout
player-idle-timeout.description: Minutes before idle players are kicked. 0 disables this.

max-tick-time.label: Max Tick Time
max-tick-time.description: Triggers the watchdog when a tick exceeds this many milliseconds. -1 disables it.

network-compression-threshold.label: Compression Threshold
network-compression-threshold.description: Packets above this byte size are compressed. -1 disables compression.

resource-pack.label: Resource Pack URL
resource-pack.description: URL for the resource pack offered when players join.

require-resource-pack.label: Require Resource Pack
require-resource-pack.description: Players must accept the resource pack before joining.

resource-pack-sha1.label: Resource Pack SHA-1
resource-pack-sha1.description: Checksum used to verify the downloaded resource pack.

createServer.title: Create New Server
createServer.wizardDescription: Work through name, core, memory, EULA, and final review in sequence.
createServer.reviewHint: After the summary looks right, Lumix will create the server and download the selected core.
createServer.nameHint: This name is shown in the list and also becomes the server folder name.
createServer.folderPreviewHint: Lumix uses a safe folder name when creating the server directory.
createServer.eulaAgree: I agree to the Minecraft EULA
createServer.eulaDescriptionLong: Before creating a server, you must read and accept Mojang's Minecraft EULA yourself. Lumix will not pre-check this box.
createServer.eulaManualConfirm: Confirm that you have reviewed the terms and accept the operational responsibility.
createServer.javaInstallFailed: Failed to install Java, please try again later
createServer.javaInstallMaxRetries: Maximum retry limit reached ({{max}} attempts). Please try again later or install Java manually
createServer.java8Required: This version requires Java 8, but Java 8 is not found on your system. Please install Java 8 before creating the server.
createServer.safeRamLimit: Recommended ceiling to avoid freezing Windows: {{value}} GB
createServer.ramRecommendationHint: Lumix uses a conservative suggestion based on core type and local hardware.
createServer.ramRecommendationSafe: Current allocation is within the recommended range
createServer.ramRecommendationMessage: The recommendation is around {{recommended}} GB, with a local safety ceiling near {{safeMax}} GB. Going beyond that can make Windows and background apps unstable.

ramProfiles.vanilla: Vanilla usually needs less memory and fits smaller worlds well.
ramProfiles.paper: Paper is suited for everyday multiplayer servers and usually runs efficiently.
ramProfiles.fabric: Fabric is friendlier to modded and performance-focused setups, so leave some headroom.
ramProfiles.forge: Forge and larger modpacks need more memory, so start higher.

name.title: Server Name
name.description: Define the name and folder preview first.

core.title: Core & Version
core.description: Choose the server core and Minecraft version.

ram.title: Smart RAM Recommendation
ram.description: Use local RAM and CPU data to pick a safer memory profile.

eula.title: Minecraft EULA
eula.description: The user must accept it manually.

review.title: Review & Create
review.description: Check the summary and start provisioning.

vanilla.description: Closest to official Minecraft behavior with the simplest setup.
vanilla.usage: Best for pure survival, small private servers, and minimal maintenance.

paper.description: A common high-performance server core with mature plugin support.
paper.usage: Best for community servers, day-to-day multiplayer, and stable TPS.

fabric.description: A lightweight modding core that usually updates quickly.
fabric.usage: Best for performance mods, technical playstyles, and lean mod stacks.

forge.description: Traditional large mod ecosystem with broad compatibility.
forge.usage: Best for classic modpacks and content-heavy tech or adventure servers.

review.javaCompatibilityWarning: No directly usable Java {{version}}+ is currently available. Installing it first is recommended.

serverImport.title: Import Existing Server
serverImport.selectDescription: Choose an existing Minecraft server folder. Lumix will scan it first and let you review the detected details.
serverImport.reviewDescription: Confirm the detected values and fill in anything Lumix could not determine reliably.
serverImport.directoryPlaceholder: Choose or paste the server folder path
serverImport.deleteWarning: This only removes the server from Lumix. The original folder will not be deleted.

review.noWarnings: No additional warnings. You can proceed with the import.

errors.selectDirectory: Unable to open the folder picker
errors.directoryRequired: Choose a folder to import first
errors.scanFailed: Failed to scan the server folder
errors.duplicateName: A server with this name already exists

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Tune Lumix's workspace, default resources, and Java runtime environment.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose the interface theme and display language that match your desktop environment.
settings.defaultsDescription: These values apply to newly created servers. Existing servers can still be adjusted individually.
settings.defaultRamDescription: Maximum memory allocation used when creating a new server.
settings.javaDescription: Manage available Java installations. Lumix selects a compatible runtime based on the Minecraft version.
settings.noJavaDescription: Use detection to scan local Java installations, or install the required runtime while creating a server.

toast.noJavaFound: No Java installation found. Please install Java first.
toast.noCompatibleJava: No compatible Java version found for this Minecraft version
toast.duplicateServerName: Server name already exists, please use a different name
toast.javaCannotRemove: System-detected Java cannot be manually removed

about.title: About
about.tagline: A desktop control center for Minecraft server setup, lifecycle management, downloads, and day-to-day maintenance.
about.updateIdleDescription: Run a manual check to see whether a newer release is available.

downloaded.title: Update Downloaded
downloaded.description: Restart the application to install the update
